title: chore: remove unused Micro app
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the unused `apps/micro` email microservice, including its routes, examples, tests, configuration, and standalone lockfile.
- Removes the stale Micro catalog entry from `apps/APPS.md` and regenerates `apps/GREENHOUSE.md`.
- Audit found no imports, callers, deployment registration, workspace entry, or external service references.
- Net change: 32 files, 2 additions, 6,054 deletions.

Checks:
- `node .github/scripts/app-update-greenhouse.js`
- `git diff --check`
- Repository-wide stale-reference scan

gist.headline: One less abandoned hive
gist.blurb: The unused Micro email app has been carefully composted: routes, examples, tests, config, and its catalog entry are gone. No callers were found, so the garden has a little more room to grow.
gist.summary: Removed the unused apps/micro email microservice and its 32 associated routes, examples, tests, configuration files, standalone lockfile, and stale catalog references after a repository-wide audit found no callers or deployment registration.
gist.impact: Developers get a cleaner app catalog and repository with no stale Micro service surface to maintain, while active Pollinations services remain unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a gentle garden caretaker tidying an unused tiny email-server shed from the community-app garden, with a retired envelope sign being placed into a compost bin while healthy code-plants and flowers remain. The scene represents safe removal after confirming nothing depends on the old service.
